chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿid al-Madaʾini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ʿAmmar al-Sabati, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the جنازة: when it is carried, what should the one carrying it say? He said: “He says: In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, forgive the believing men and the believing women.”

key_terms.اغْفِرْ: forgive; a plea for divine pardon
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or deceased person being carried
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: in the Name of Allah; opening invocation of divine remembrance
key_terms.وَبِاللَّهِ: and by Allah; expressing reliance upon and connection to Allah
key_terms.وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ م: a formula of blessings upon Muhammad and his family
key_terms.يَحْمِلُهَا: carries it; refers to bearing the جنازة

ai.seo_question: What should a person say when carrying a جنازة according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the supplication to be recited by one who carries a جنازة. It combines remembrance of Allah, salawat upon Muhammad and آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and seeking forgiveness for the المؤمنين and المؤمنات, reflecting proper devotional etiquette at the time of death.
